candidate_relations.reason: The patient presents with severe hypertension, neurological symptoms (seizure, confusion, headache, blurred vision), and imaging findings (cortical and subcortical hypodensities in posterior parasagittal parietal and medial right occipital lobes) highly suggestive of PRES. Hypertensive encephalopathy is a common cause of PRES, but PRES is the more specific and encompassing diagnosis given the imaging confirmation.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Hypertensive encephalopathy is a cause/subtype of PRES, but PRES is the more specific diagnosis given the imaging findings.
